change_summary: Implemented Phase 2 of the stock document model (D-31): CashierShift, Sale.ShiftId, cancel/modify audit fields, automatic shift open on first sale, the D-24 edit-window gate and the MRB partial sales return.
Added the AddCashierShiftsAndSaleAudit migration with a filtered unique index preventing two open shifts for the same (store, cashier).
Froze shift totals on close: SalesTotal for non-cancelled sales, CashTotal for paid non-credit sales, CreditTotal for remaining credit sales.
The stock card now shows a cancelled sale as the original outbound entry plus a cancel inbound entry dated CancelledAt, keeping the stored balance reconciled.
Updated the verified test counts to Domain 24/24 and Integration 245/245 (269 total).
Kept the approved MVP scope and the Phase 3 boundary (cash, purchases, UI, permissions, sync) unchanged and unauthorized.
